summary: US military strikes hit multiple Iranian targets including Abadan, Mahshahr, and Isfahan province, prompting Iranian missile and drone retaliation against US bases in Bahrain, Jordan, Kuwait, and Oman. IDF struck a Hamas weapons manufacturing site in Gaza City, killing four per Palestinian media, and eliminated two Hamas operatives in northern Gaza planning imminent attacks. Houthi forces confronted Saudi jets attempting to block an Iranian civilian plane from landing at Sanaa International Airport, while Saudi airstrikes targeted the airport.
key_points: US strikes hit three sites in Abadan, Khuzestan at 13:45 local time, injuring one person per Khuzestan deputy governor. (Source: @naya_foriraq/82688)
IDF bombed a Hamas weapons manufacturing site in Gaza City while operatives were inside; Palestinian media reported four fatalities. (Source: @manniefabian/58781)
Iran launched missiles and drones at US bases in Jordan, Bahrain, Kuwait, and vessels in response to US strikes, per Iranian claims. (Source: @almogboker78/17705)
Sirens sounded in Bahrain for the third time overnight; Ministry of Interior urged civilians to seek shelter. (Source: @shin_persian/7757)
Houthi military spokesman announced confrontation with Saudi jets over Iranian plane to Sanaa, threatening attacks on Saudi airports and vital interests. (Source: @asafroz/51368)
Saudi airstrikes targeted Sanaa International Airport with warplanes continuing to fly overhead. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/376815)
IRGC claimed destruction of long-range air surveillance radar (FPS) and ship detection radar in Oman during fifth phase of response. (Source: @naya_foriraq/82664)
US CENTCOM confirmed strikes on dozens of Iranian targets including air defense, radar, missile/drone sites, and fast attack craft in Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @yediotnews25/132583)

sections.executive_summary: US military strikes hit multiple Iranian targets including Abadan, Mahshahr, and Isfahan province, prompting Iranian missile and drone retaliation against US bases in Bahrain, Jordan, Kuwait, and Oman. IDF struck a Hamas weapons manufacturing site in Gaza City, killing four per Palestinian media, and eliminated two Hamas operatives in northern Gaza planning imminent attacks. Houthi forces confronted Saudi jets attempting to block an Iranian civilian plane from landing at Sanaa International Airport, while Saudi airstrikes targeted the airport.

points: US strikes hit Abadan, Khuzestan at 13:45 local time on Monday 22 Tir, targeting three sites and injuring one person, according to Khuzestan deputy governor. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/75896, @naya_foriraq/82688)

Additional US strikes reported on Mahshahr city, with explosions also heard in Chabahar, Minab, and Sirik, indicating a broad targeting campaign across southern Iran. (Source: @New_security8200/202506, @inon_yttach/9402)
A US strike near Nain district in Isfahan province killed one and wounded seven, per Iranian reports. (Source: @New_security8200/202515)
Iranian missile launches detected from Khomein and Aligudarz, with explosions heard near Arak, and additional launch reports from Zanjan and Alvand areas. (Source: @VahidOnline/76985)

IRGC Navy claimed missile and drone strikes destroyed a long-range air surveillance radar (FPS) and ship detection radar in Oman, and targeted US facilities in Juffair, Bahrain, causing fires. (Source: @naya_foriraq/82664)
Iran claimed to have shot down a US LUCAS one-way attack drone over Bandar Abbas, per Tasnim news agency. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/4906)
A severe storm with winds up to 76 km/h hit western Khorasan Razavi province, affecting Davarzan county and Mashhad, unrelated to military operations. (Source: @SharghDaily/171624)

IDF struck a Hamas weapons manufacturing site in Gaza City while operatives were producing weapon components to restore capabilities, calling it a ceasefire violation; Palestinian media reported four killed. (Source: @manniefabian/58781)

IDF eliminated two Hamas operatives in northern Gaza: Hassan Mustafa Zahir Al-Razina, who attempted to plant explosives near the yellow line, and Muhammad Mahmoud Abd Al-Muti Fayoumi, a Nukhba operative advancing imminent terror plots; both killed in airstrikes. (Source: @almogboker78/17702, @idf_telegram/24603)

New York Times reported Israel planned post-regime change scenario in Iran during the war, recruiting former president Mahmoud Ahmadinejad; former Mossad chief Dadi Barnea met him in Hungary, and a covert extraction operation moved him to a Mossad safehouse in Iran, but Ahmadinejad later left distrustful. (Source: @pkpoi/143254, @asafroz/51363)

On February 28, Israel struck the compound where Ahmadinejad was staying, targeting his security building and armored vehicle; a black Peugeot extracted him, reportedly driven by Mossad agents to a secret Iranian safehouse. (Source: @asafroz/51363)
Israeli police and special units arrested dozens nationwide on suspicion of arms and drug trafficking in a large-scale raid. (Source: @yediotnews25/132581)

IDF airstrike on Hamas weapons manufacturing site in Gaza City killed four people according to Palestinian media, with IDF stating operatives were manufacturing weapon components to restore capabilities in violation of ceasefire. (Source: @manniefabian/58781)

IDF eliminated two Hamas terrorists in northern Gaza who posed immediate threat: one attempted to plant explosives near the yellow line, the other a Nukhba operative advancing imminent attack plans. (Source: @almogboker78/17702, @idf_telegram/24603)
Israeli indictment filed against Reut Ben Haim for blocking humanitarian aid trucks destined for Gaza. (Source: @amitsegal/62997)
Two years ago, IDF eliminated Muhammad Deif, head of Hamas military wing, in Khan Younis. (Source: @yediotnews25/132583, @inon_yttach/9407)
Artillery shelling reported in Nabatieh Al-Fawqa area in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/31141)
Red alert issued for warplanes flying towards Lebanon, urging maximum caution. (Source: @redlinkleb/31138)
Investigation reveals massive Iranian-built tunnels under Beaufort Castle, Hezbollah's strategic fortress overlooking Metula in northern Israel. (Source: @inon_yttach/9408)

Iranian missile launches originated from Khomein and Aligudarz in western Iran, with explosions heard near Arak, and additional launch reports from Zanjan and Alvand, indicating possible cross-border coordination. (Source: @VahidOnline/76985)
Explosion and fire reported at Omidiyeh Airport in Khuzestan around 3 am local time. (Source: @VahidOnline/76980)
Chazabeh border terminal (Iran-Iraq border) reportedly targeted by attacks. (Source: @kianmeli1/88897)
Sirens activated in Bahrain three times overnight; Ministry of Interior urged calm and movement to nearest safe place. (Source: @shin_persian/7757, @asafroz/51356)
Kuwait Armed Forces engaged hostile aerial targets in Kuwaiti airspace; General Staff stated explosion sounds were air defense interceptions. (Source: @shin_persian/7758)
IRGC claimed strikes on US bases in Jordan, Bahrain (Juffair), Kuwait, and vessels, plus destruction of radars in Oman. (Source: @naya_foriraq/82664, @almogboker78/17705)

Houthi forces confronted Saudi fighter jets attempting to prevent Iranian civilian plane landing at Sanaa International Airport; Houthis threatened attacks on Saudi airports and vital interests. (Source: @asafroz/51368)
Saudi airstrikes targeted Sanaa International Airport with warplanes continuing to fly overhead. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/376815)
